ann.t: Pursuant to Regulation 47 of SEBI (LODR) Regulations, 2015, as amended, please find enclosed herewith the copies of newspaper publication of extract of Un-Audited Financial Results for the Quarter and Half-Year ended on 30th September, 2026 in Financial Express and Jan Satta Newspaper.

Trinity League India Ltdhas informed BSE that the meeting of the Board of Directors of the Company is scheduled on 13/11/2026 ,inter alia, to consider and approve the un-audited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter ended on 30.09.2026
